caption_L1: This is a bar chart labeled Motivation to participate in outdoor activities among Hispanics in the United States in 2017. There is a scale from 0.0 to 0.6 on the y-axis, labeled Share of respondents. The x-axis plots Response using a categorical scale from Be close to nature to Talk to new and varied people.
caption_L2L3: The main motivation to participate in outdoor activities is exercise. The second highest motivation was to keep fit. Both of the two top reasons are for health benefits. The least motivation was to talk to new and varied people.
